ServiceDependency.description: A single inter-service dependency with its optional Compose condition, required, and restart flags.
ServiceDependency.title: Service Dependency

ServiceDependencyCondition.description: How a service dependency must be satisfied before dependents start: on process start, on healthcheck success, or on successful completion.
ServiceDependencyCondition.title: Service Dependency Condition

checksum.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the imported bytes.

layer.description: Landofile layer that authored the import.

path.description: Path as authored in the source Landofile.

allowOverride.description: Whether an Apache-backed service enables .htaccess overrides for its webroot.

build.description: Build configuration using either Lando build-script keys (artifact, app) or Compose image-build keys (context, dockerfile, dockerfile_inline, args, target); mixing the families is rejected. Compose accepts a bare context string and defaults an omitted object context to ".". The canonical decoded form keeps dockerfileInline and encodes it back to dockerfile_inline.

cap_add.description: Linux capabilities added to the container; a scalar canonicalizes to a list.

cap_drop.description: Linux capabilities removed from the container; a scalar canonicalizes to a list.

cert.description: Path to a custom leaf certificate for this service.

key.description: Path to the private key matching the custom leaf certificate.

certs.description: Leaf TLS certificate for this service: true issues one from the active certificate authority, false disables issuance, a path supplies a custom certificate, and an object supplies an explicit certificate and key. Separate from security.ca, which adds trusted certificate authorities.

configs.description: Service config grants as source-name strings or long entries; canonicalized to long entries, carried losslessly into ServicePlan.extensions.compose and capability-checked; no Lando-side activation.

dependsOn.description: Inter-service dependencies as a service-name list or a Compose condition-map; canonicalized to structured entries.

deploy.description: Container resource limits and reservations; Swarm orchestration fields are rejected.

devices.description: Host device mappings; short source:target[:permissions] entries canonicalize to objects.

dns.description: Custom DNS servers; a scalar address canonicalizes to a list.

dns_opt.description: Resolver options; a scalar option canonicalizes to a list.

dns_search.description: Custom DNS search domains; a scalar domain canonicalizes to a list.

publication.description: Explicit host-publication intent and policy overrides.

envFile.description: One or more env-file paths (string or list) whose KEY=value lines seed the service environment.

environment.description: Service environment variables as a map (KEY: value) or a Compose-style KEY=value list. A bare list entry or null map value is rejected because Landofiles do not read host environment variables.

expose.description: Container-only ports exposed to other services as strings, numbers, or ranges; never host-published, and normalized into internal endpoints.

extra_hosts.description: Additional hostname mappings as a map or HOST:IP list, canonicalized to a map.

gpus.description: GPU allocation as all devices or a list of driver-specific device requests.

group_add.description: Supplementary container groups; a scalar group canonicalizes to a list.

healthcheck.description: Healthcheck as canonical Lando fields or Compose test, disable, and duration spellings; canonicalized to the Lando healthcheck model while preserving start_interval losslessly.

init.description: Whether an init process forwards signals and reaps child processes in the container.

labels.description: Service labels as a map or a Compose-style KEY=value list; canonicalized to a map, with null and bare entries becoming empty strings.

logging.description: Container logging driver and driver-specific scalar options.

path.description: Single absolute in-container file path declared under `services.<name>.logs`.

stream.description: Render and exit classification for this source's lines; defaults to stderr.

networks.description: Service network attachments as a name list or long mapping; canonicalized to a long mapping and carried losslessly into ServicePlan.extensions.compose and capability-checked; no Lando-side activation.

platform.description: Target runtime platform in operating-system and architecture form.

ports.description: Published container ports as Compose short strings ("8080:80", "127.0.0.1:8080:80/udp", "80", ranges) or long objects; canonicalized to target/published/hostIp/protocol entries that normalize into endpoints.

privileged.description: Whether the container runs with extended host privileges.

profiles.description: Compose profile names; carried losslessly into ServicePlan.extensions.compose and capability-checked; no Lando-side activation.

pull_policy.description: Upstream Compose policy controlling when the service image is pulled.

read_only.description: Whether the container root filesystem is mounted read-only.

restart.description: Container restart policy: no, always, on-failure, or unless-stopped.

secrets.description: Service secret grants as source-name strings or long entries; canonicalized to long entries, carried losslessly into ServicePlan.extensions.compose and capability-checked; no Lando-side activation.

security.description: Additional CA paths and per-service overrides for inheriting host network CA and proxy settings.

security_opt.description: Container security labeling options; a scalar option canonicalizes to a list.

shm_size.description: Shared-memory allocation in bytes or as a Compose byte-size literal, canonicalized to bytes.

stop_grace_period.description: Graceful shutdown duration as Compose syntax, canonicalized to seconds.

stop_signal.description: Signal used to request graceful container shutdown, such as SIGTERM.

sysctls.description: Container kernel parameters as a map or KEY=value list, canonicalized to a map.

tmpfs.description: Temporary filesystem mounts; a scalar mount specification canonicalizes to a list.

ulimits.description: Process resource limits; scalar limits canonicalize to explicit soft and hard values.

volumes.description: Compose volumes as short strings ("./src:/app", "named:/data:ro", "/data") or long objects; host paths normalize into mounts, named and anonymous volumes into storage, and tmpfs into the preserved tmpfs runtime knob.

webroot.description: Container path served as this service's HTTP document root.
